Shipping a release

Every element below is what a markdown renderer writes. Press Ctrl + K to search, and read the CHANGELOG first. The build takes about two minutes. Lookups take log 2 n steps, and the cache holds 104 entries.

Steps

  1. Bump the version
    • Patch for fixes
    • Minor for features
  2. Tag the commit

Checklist

  • Tests pass
  • Docs updated

Terms

Changeset
A file naming the packages a change bumps, and by how much.
What if the build fails?

Fix it on a branch and tag again. A failed build publishes nothing.

Last reviewed in October 2026.
